I recently graduated from Carnegie Mellon University (CMU), with university honors, earning
a degree in mathematics and computer science. I blog here about things I find interesting.

My favorite classes at CMU have been Theoretical Computer Science (15-251),
Markov Chains (21-326) and Computational Biology (02-251).
